articles.title: Infantino apologises to Fifa Council - but told he is still not fit to lead
articles.summary: President Gianni Infantino apologises to the Fifa Council for his World Cup sell-off plan - but is asked to go further.

articles.title: Infantino sorry for World Cup plan and set to ditch award previously given to Trump
articles.summary: FIFA president Gianni Infantino has apologised for his World Cup sell-off plan at a three-hour FIFA Council meeting in Zurich on Thursday - and the Peace Prize he awarded to US President Donald Trump
